description: issue #688 (terminal slice, review round 1): the ACTIVE half of `spec/interaction-events.md:43-46` -- `when`, `every`, `on_key`, and `on_click` are profile block-heads, and they are reserved WITHIN the Interaction & Events profile. Redefining any of the four with `define` raises `ol-reserved-word`, and all four are asserted in one program so a fix that reserved only the name a single fixture happened to pick cannot pass. This used to pin `params.namespace: "reserved"` to distinguish these four from the profile's ordinary primitive `wait` (sibling `redefine-wait-reserved`, which pinned `"primitive"`); issue #838 removed the param, because spec/error-model.md:125 forbids the words *keyword*, *primitive* and *alias* from the learner message and gives the code `params: { name }` only. The branch distinction survives in the checker, not in the diagnostic. Before this fixture the corpus proved the primitive branch only, so the four block-heads' reservation -- a normative MUST -- rested on unit tests alone and no other implementation was bound by it (the same gap class the Sprites terminal slice #679 found for its own `ol-reserved-word` rule). Its twin `block-heads-free-core-only` proves the `only within` half: the SAME source is clean Core-only -- a profile gate spec/grammar.md:408 has since overruled, whose retirement is issue #841 and which #838 deliberately left standing. This is a check-mode fixture: it proves static legality only and does not execute.
